adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff adds a refresh-token HTTP request and `prisma.credential.update(...)` immediately after `const credentialKey = credential.key ...` and before constructing the `jsforce.Connection`, with no conditional/expiry check shown. It also throws on non-OK (`if (response.statusText !== "OK") throw ...`), meaning any transient refresh failure will fail service initialization even if the existing cached `access_token` might still work. This introduces an unconditional network round-trip and DB write on each instantiation/path that reaches this code, matching the finding.
